title: Micro-app idea scan from TrustMRR: 10 small apps with verified revenue that solve ONE problem and get users from a platform store (Chrome Web Store, Google Workspace Marketplace, Play Store)
details: Method from Starter Story 'How I Made $1M Building 30 Micro-Apps' (Sanskar Tiwari: 30+ products, 8 earning, ideas from TrustMRR revenue signals). Use ONLY TrustMRR's public AI endpoints (its llms.txt says: do not scrape the website): https://trustmrr.com/api/ai/discovery (25 fastest-growing + 25 newest) and https://trustmrr.com/startup/{slug}.md pages. For each: name, link, verified MRR, one-line problem, store it lives on, could Kalpa build a v1 in under 2 weeks (yes/no + why). Facts only from those pages; mark anything else UNVERIFIED. Don't copy anyone's product or brand.
